Windows 没有允许把目标窗口切到前台（前台锁）。可以请用户点一下目标窗口，: Windows did not allow bringing the target window to the foreground (foreground lock). Ask the user to click the target window, or try activate_window later; this screenshot is view-only.
整屏观察只供查看。要操作某个程序，请用 get_active_windows 找: Full-screen observations are view-only. To operate a program, find its windowId with get_active_windows, then observe with take_screenshot and that windowId (the window is brought to the foreground first).
目标窗口已最小化，截不到它的画面。传 windowId 观察时系统会先把它还原并: The target window is minimized, so it cannot be captured. Observing with windowId restores it and brings it to the foreground first; if that is blocked, ask the user to restore the window and try again.
目标窗口被其他窗口挡住了一部分，截图里那部分是上层窗口的内容。可以传 windo: Part of the target window is covered by other windows; that part of the screenshot shows the window on top. Observe again with windowId (brings it to the foreground), or ask the user to move the covering window.
目标程序以管理员权限运行，Windows 会拦下 infOS 的模拟点击和输入。: The target program runs as administrator, so Windows blocks infOS's simulated clicks and typing. It can be viewed; the user has to operate it, or run infOS as administrator.
